health.title: Live health
health.description: Median of 5 quick probes. Refreshes every 15 seconds.
health.thresholds: Slow from {slow} ms, down from {down} ms
health.auto: Latency is measured from the API process, not from your browser.

jobs.title: Failed background jobs
jobs.description: Outbox events that ran out of retries. Error text is shortened and scrubbed.
jobs.total: {count, plural, one {# dead job} other {# dead jobs}}
jobs.empty: No failed jobs. Everything is flowing.
jobs.retryAllBody: Up to 200 dead jobs go back to the queue with a fresh attempt count. This is recorded in the audit log.
jobs.retryAllDone: {count, plural, one {# job queued for retry} other {# jobs queued for retry}}
jobs.discardBody: The job will not be delivered. The row is kept and the reason is audited.

errors.title: Errors and slow requests
errors.description: Recent server errors (5xx) and slow requests. Only method, route, status and timing are kept.
errors.scope: Held in this process memory only: it resets when the API restarts and covers only this instance. Capturing since {since}. Keeps the last {size} entries; slow means {slow} ms or more.

migrations.title: Database migrations
migrations.unavailable: Migration history is not available here. This database was probably created with prisma db push instead of migrate deploy.
migrations.problems: {count, plural, one {# migration is unfinished or rolled back} other {# migrations are unfinished or rolled back}}. Investigate before deploying.
migrations.count: {count, plural, one {# migration recorded} other {# migrations recorded}}
